SECTION 1. The PNP is hereby directed to support the AFP in
internal security operations (ISO) for the suppression of insurgency and
other serious threats to national security.
For this purpose, the PNP is
authorized to make appropriate adjustments
in its organization
to the approval of the National Police Commission.
